output.summary: Request is too vague (“Make it better”) to safely change the right timing/logic without knowing the target goal.
questions: What does “better” mean for you here: higher throughput (lower lineCycle), better quality (more rejects), or better flow (less rework / fewer stoppages)?
If throughput: should we reduce the bottleneck station “pack” cycle time (currently 4s in the pack station), and if so by how much (e.g., target lineCycle ≤ X)?

If quality: should the reject rate be adjusted (currently product param rejectEvery=4, and inspection currently routes all “reject” to rework—do you want rework to also re-enter at fill or just re-check in inspect)?
Do you want rework to loop back into “inspect” instead of going forward to packing (right now the rejected items go to “rework” and then continue to “pack”)?
